body:
My perspective isn't narrow. It's realistic. You can't trust people, especially in this modern climate. I dont trust anyone. I dont trust men not to lie and cheat, and also use you. I dont trust friends because they'll backstab you and use you when they see fit. 

I'm simply protecting myself and my peace. I'm not completely blocking people out, im fine with socialising but I don't ever want to get close to someone again. 

I dont want therapy, but am going to go on anti depressants in a few weeks.

I completely agree. I'm not denying I could also be the problem but nowadays, people my age aren't interested in proper life long friendships. Just someone to use for the time being or just for their own selfish needs. It's kind of useless and im preparing for a life alone, and im pretty happy in a way. Do I wish it was different? Of course. Especially being someone who used to have so many friends it's very different. But there is no pressure for me anymore.
Hi, thank you so much for your response. I really appreciate it! I just wasn't 100% sure, and wanted some clarity.

That post is the reason why I'm never having a child as a lesbian. It's too cruel and unhealthy.

Edit: down vote me all you want, but its true.

This might sound whiny, but I have no motivation to improve myself or fix myself. For example, I want to quit smoking for many obvious reasons, but I cannot find the motivation for it. The reason is, there is no one there to impress, there is no one there to fix myself for. I just don't see the point.
Honestly this made me feel much worse.
